# gitmoap_repository_tag (Resource)

Tags a commit, named by its SHA or by a branch whose tip it is. With a `message` the tag is annotated, with you as the tagger; without one it is lightweight. Developers and above may create tags; a name already taken is refused, and a service account can create only lightweight tags.

The token needs `tag:create`, `tag:read` and `tag:delete`.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `repo_id` (String) Repository ID
- `tag_name` (String) Tag name
- `target` (String)

### Optional

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by its repo_id and tag_name, joined with slashes.
terraform import gitmoap_repository_tag.example "<repo_id>/<tag_name>"
```
